verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his Counter Strike stun or get caught before Ground Slam is up; you win if you poke with Q, shred his attack speed with E, and scale into Thornmail and Frozen Heart for the late-game teamfight.

brief.thesis: Jax's entire damage pattern is basic-attack-based: Empower buffs a single attack, Relentless Assault rewards landing consecutive hits, and Counter Strike's stun only connects if you swing into it. Malphite's E (Ground Slam) attack-speed reduction and W (Brutal Strikes)'s armor/AD buff are built to break exactly that pattern, and his 625-range Q (Seismic Shard) denies him free approach distance. The 52.1% win rate over 144 games reflects a lane that's even overall but swings to Jax in the short all-in window once his Q, W, and E are all simultaneously up.

theirWindow.when: his Q, W, and E are all up
theirWindow.what: Expect a full combo: Leap Strike in, an Empowered auto, then Counter Strike's stun chaining into Relentless Assault auto-stacking. Don't contest this trade — back off and let your Granite Shield recharge instead.

yourWindow.what: He has no stun or dodge window to punish an auto-trade. Pop W (Brutal Strikes) for the armor/AD buff and shove the wave or force a short trade on your terms.

start.why: Mana sustain keeps Q and E in constant rotation for poke and attack-speed shred, while the potion offsets his early all-in burst before Plated Steelcaps comes online.

boots.why: Nearly all of Jax's damage comes from basic attacks — Empower, auto-trades, Relentless Assault stacking — so flat reduction on autos cuts his output more than any other boot choice.

core.why: Early armor and health plus a passive burn gives you durability and damage in extended trades while your armor total scales Ground Slam.
Directly punishes his auto-reliant kit — Grievous Wounds and damage return hurt him most on exactly the Empower and Relentless Assault patterns he leans on.
The attack speed slow aura undercuts Relentless Assault's stacking and Empower's follow-up window, on top of mana for Q/E spam.

situational.when: their team stacks burst magic damage onto you
you need more sustain and AoE presence for extended teamfights
you're ahead and want to prioritize R engage burst over pure tank stats

runes.keystoneWhy: Jax's threat is a short burst window, not sustained poke, so Grasp rewards you for landing autos in the extended trades you're forcing and keeps your Granite Shield topped up between his cooldowns.

summoners.why: This is a scaling, shape-defensive matchup, not an early-kill one — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Q and W farm while you build toward Sunfire/Thornmail/Frozen Heart, and Flash covers or punishes his Leap Strike engage.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't auto
playing.detail: Use Seismic Shard (8s cooldown, 625 range) to chip him and steal his movement speed before he can close with Leap Strike, rather than trading autos into his stance.

playing.title: Hold trades for his E cooldown
playing.detail: Counter Strike (18/16/14/12/10s CD) dodges your incoming basic attacks then stuns around him — only commit to an auto-trade once you've seen it burn or bait it out first.

playing.title: Shred his R with Ground Slam
playing.detail: E's attack-speed reduction directly cuts into Relentless Assault's stacking and third-hit bonus, so land it the instant he commits to an extended auto exchange.

playing.title: Bank R for his engage
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (130-80s CD, 1000 range) lets you answer his Leap Strike gap-close rather than needing to initiate first — save it instead of using it to start fights you don't need.

playing.title: Build through armor, not raw health
playing.detail: His damage is almost entirely basic-attack-based, so Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail cut his output far more than raw HP stacking would.

playing.title: Don't force solo kills
playing.detail: The lane is even overall (52.1% over 144 games), but he keeps the solo-kill edge from his Counter Strike burst — play the shove-and-scale game instead of hunting all-ins.

playing.title: Back off on his W glow
playing.detail: Empower (7-3s CD) buffs his next attack or Leap Strike with bonus damage that also hits nearby enemies, so disengage when you see the buff trigger instead of eating the enhanced hit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Jax deals a lot of damage with his (W) and third strike after learning (R). Use [R] to reduce his attack speed when Jax closes in.
